Jordan (CSM): Heads up — MeridianLabs usage down ~60% week-over-week. Our primary advocate Sam left last Thurs, and procurement just asked about a LexaAI pilot. Need quick renewal triage.
Maria (CS Ops): On it — pulling the usage dashboard now. Which routes did they hit most?
Jordan (CSM): Mostly embeddings and the chat endpoint (/v1/chat). Top app is internal summarization.
eng-alert-bot: ALERT: acct=meridianlabs (ML-7743) tokens -62% vs prior month — triggered 2025-10-12T09:03:11Z
Maria (CS Ops): @Aj any contract/renewal dates?
Aj (AE): Renewal 2026-01-15, enterprise seat + 150k ARR. Procurement contact is Priya (priya@meridian.com). Sales will engage.
Elaine (Product): @Jordan any product complaints recently? Anything Lexa is advertising that we don't match?
Jordan (CSM): They called out ingest latency on large batches. Mentioned Lexa's faster batch ingest. No formal bug filed aside from chat in support ticket #5678.
Maria (CS Ops): Proposed immediate plan:
- 1) 30m tech + procurement call to triage perf
- 2) Offer 6-week pilot extension + usage credits
- 3) Short-term routing/kv-cache change to lower latency and cost
Who owns each item?
Sam (Growth): I can draft the outreach and pilot terms.
Ben (EngRuntime): I'll investigate KV cache/batching settings for ML-7743. Can you drop p95 numbers for last 72h?
Jordan (CSM): p95 chat_tokenize: baseline ~1.8s, spike to 5.2s during heavy ingest on 10/11. Logs attached to ticket #5678.
Aj (AE): I'm ok to offer a 6-week extension + credits if CS handles the enablement.
Maria (CS Ops): Scheduling call for tomorrow 11:00 AM PT. Agenda: root-cause, immediate mitigations, pilot terms. Assignments: @Ben gather p95 graphs, @Sam draft pilot annex, @Jordan collate support logs.
Priya (Meridian): Thanks — procurement asks for an exec-level ROI snapshot comparing us to Lexa. Can you provide?
Jordan (CSM): We'll prepare ROI: current monthly cost, estimated cost after quantized model + caching, and expected latency change. ETA 48h.
Maria (CS Ops): Risk = medium-high. If they validate Lexa before renewal, threat is real. If pilot not started within 72h escalate to AE director.
Aj (AE): I'll attend the call and emphasize our observability + private deploy options.
Sam (Growth): Outreach draft: "Hi Priya — sorry to hear about the team change. We'd like to propose a 6-week pilot extension with dedicated SRE support to validate ingest performance. Can we set a 30-min slot tomorrow 11am PT? — Sam"
Jordan (CSM): Sent.
Priya (Meridian): Confirmed 11am PT tomorrow. Looking forward.
Maria (CS Ops): Next internal steps: create linked support ticket (#5678) and tag playbook: renewal_competitor_push.
Ben (EngRuntime): Repro snippet I'll use to emulate their ingest job:
```bash
# reproduce heavy ingest job against test harness
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/test/ingest -d @large_batch.json -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
```
Ben (EngRuntime): I'll attach p95 graphs and a short note on batching/kv-cache changes before the call.
Jordan (CSM): Thanks team. Update this thread after the call with decisions. :thumbsup:
